annotations.label: Seattle / strongest recovered signal
annotations.description: The largest city-level recovered privacy signal in this layer.

annotations.label: Low-elevation signal cluster
annotations.description: Most high-signal points sit near coastal or low-elevation institutional and technology centers.

annotations.label: Johannesburg / high-elevation counterpoint
annotations.description: A useful reminder that elevation is context, not a causal explanation.

strong_signals: 90 city-level records include latitude, longitude, elevation, and recovered privacy signal counts.
The strongest recovered city signals are concentrated in low-elevation institutional and platform centers.
High-elevation points exist as counterpoints, but do not dominate the recovered signal.
limitations: Elevation is a spatial attribute and does not imply causation.
Record counts are recovered source signals, not population-normalized search interest.
Google Trends regional data remains unavailable in this local reproducible pipeline.
Some city points are institution/news-source centroids rather than complete public attention measurements.
source_notes: City point elevations come from the geo_spatial_metrics layer where latitude/longitude enrichment was available.
The geo_spatial_metrics aggregate by elevation band is preserved as source context.
